name: reverse a password hash/check to a valid secret
definition: Analyze a compiled validation routine and invert its check (e.g. a hash or implementable hash inverse) to obtain an input that the valid system accepts.

name: run a crypto CLI over every file in a source directory
definition: invoke the installed encryption command on each file in the input folder so everything gets encoded.
failure_mode: any file skipped or written to the wrong file fails that specific check

name: select the strongest encryption mode the tool offers
definition: discover the tool's most secure option (optionally via its man page) and pass it to every invocation.
failure_mode: falling back to the default/weak mode produces different ciphertext than expected

name: tokenize text fields with a specific downloaded tokenizer
definition: Load the designated instruction tokenizer and apply it to the two relevant text columns, summing the token lengths across all filtered rows.
failure_mode: Using the wrong tokenizer/columns/iteration computes the count does not match the expected integer.
